mapper.select: SELECT transaction_id AS transactionId, amount AS amount, transaction_date AS date, transaction_time AS time, category AS category FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_type = 'BANK_TRANSACTION' AND type = 'TRANSFER' AND category IN ('SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND ( merchant_name LIKE '%체크%' OR merchant_name LIKE '%카드%' OR merchant_name LIKE '%가맹%' OR original_merchant_name LIKE '%체크%' OR original_merchant_name LIKE '%카드%' OR original_merchant_name LIKE '%가맹%' ) ORDER BY transaction_date, transaction_time, transaction_id

SELECT card_transaction.transaction_id AS transactionId, card_transaction.amount AS amount, card_transaction.transaction_date AS date, card_transaction.transaction_time AS time, card_transaction.category AS category FROM TRANSACTIONS card_transaction INNER JOIN CARDS card ON card.card_id = card_transaction.card_id WHERE card_transaction.user_id = #{userId} AND card_transaction.source_type = 'CARD_APPROVAL' AND card_transaction.type = 'EXPENSE' AND UPPER(card.card_type) IN ('CHECK', 'DEBIT', '1') ORDER BY card_transaction.transaction_date, card_transaction.transaction_time, card_transaction.transaction_id
mapper.update: UPDATE TRANSACTIONS SET category = #{category}, category_source = CASE WHEN #{category} = 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL' THEN 'CARD_RECONCILIATION' ELSE 'BANK_DIRECTION' END, category_confidence = 1.0000, classifier_version = CASE WHEN #{category} = 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL' THEN 'card-bank-match-v1' ELSE 'bank-direction-v1' END WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND source_type = 'BANK_TRANSACTION' AND type = 'TRANSFER'
